text: DSH AIOps（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DSH Web 接入 Alertmanager 告警驱动的只读故障诊断。它通过 webhook 接收告警，将事件路由到诊断 Session，并提供 Prometheus、Alertmanager 与 Kubernetes 的观测工具。还可查看结构化事件历史、管理路由策略并在 Portal 中浏览运行状态。适合需要在 DSH 内调查集群告警的运维人员；需配置相应数据源与 Kubernetes 连接。

DSH AIOps (DSH Web plugin): routes Alertmanager webhooks into diagnostic Sessions and provides read-only Prometheus, Alertmanager, and Kubernetes tools. It also offers searchable incident history, routing policy review, and a Web Portal. Configure data sources and Kubernetes connection.

DSH AIOps 的功能「告警路由诊断」：接收 Alertmanager webhook，并将告警组织为持久化路由队列与诊断 Session。路由配置包含严重级别、诊断时间窗和资源预算。
DSH AIOps 的功能「只读数据源查询」：模型工具可读取 Alertmanager 告警、执行 PromQL 即时或区间查询，并从 Kubernetes 获取资源、事件与 Pod 日志。
DSH AIOps 的功能「事件历史检索」：在当前工作区列出、读取或按文字搜索持久化事件记录，也可查看操作反馈；调用参数支持结果数量限制。
DSH AIOps 的功能「Web 运维 Portal」：在 DSH Web 提供 AIOps 入口与服务端快照接口，查看事件、路由审计并管理数据源连接和路由策略。
DSH AIOps 需要分别配置 Prometheus、Alertmanager 和 Kubernetes 数据源；webhook 默认监听本机 127.0.0.1:3081，外部告警发送端需能访问所设地址。

dsh-aiops README · DSH AIOps：`dsh-aiops` is an independently built DSH bundle for Alertmanager-driven, read-only incident diagnosis. It provides authenticated webhook ingress, general fingerprint-to-Session routing with a durable queue and resource budgets, alert-time query windows, a packaged `aiops-diag` skill, dynamically selected Alertmanager, Prometheus, and Kubernetes observation capabilities, structured incident reports, append-only operator feedback, workspace-scoped history/routing audit, and a dedicated AIOps Portal inside DSH Web.

dsh-aiops README · Compatibility and installation：The current source bundle is built and tested against:

| Component | Supported version |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1` |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` |
| pnpm | `11.7.0` (`>=10` Git prepare-script approval semantics are required) |

Install the repository directly into the DSH Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jarvan1/dsh-aiops
```

Without a global DSH command, use the matching CLI version:

dsh-aiops README · Compatibility and installation：```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1 plugin --profile web add github:jarvan1/dsh-aiops
```

pnpm 10 and later will initially block the Git dependency's `prepare` script. The failed command prints an `allowBuilds` entry containing the resolved repository and commit. Copy that **exact key** into `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml` (normally `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`) and run the add command again. Its shape is:

dsh-aiops README · Compatibility and installation：```yaml
allowBuilds:
  'dsh-aiops@https://codeload.github.com/jarvan1/dsh-aiops/tar.gz/<resolved-commit-sha>': true
```

Do not replace the printed key with only `dsh-aiops`: pnpm intentionally binds this permission to the exact Git source revision.

For reproducible deployments, pin a release tag or commit, for example `github:jarvan1/dsh-aiops#<commit-sha>`. Restart DSH after installation.

dsh-aiops README · Development：```sh
pnpm install --offline
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run pack:bundle

For local development, install the bundle into a DSH profile from the checked-out package:

```sh
DSH_HOME=/path/to/profile-home pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-aiops/packages/aiops
```

dsh-aiops README · Development：The GitHub installation uses the repository root bundle and relative built plugin entries. A future registry deployment can install `@deepseek-ai/dsh-aiops`; both forms add the AIOps patch after the profile's base and application layers. `PROMETHEUS_URL`, `ALERTMANAGER_URL`, `KUBECONFIG`, and `KUBERNETES_CONTEXT` provide optional composition defaults and can be saved or overridden live in the AIOps data-source settings. `AIOPS_WORKSPACE` and the `AIOPS_ALERTMANAGER_WEBHOOK_SECRET` credential configure the automated workflow. The webhook listener defaults to `127.0.0.1:3081/alertmanager`; set `AIOPS_WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_URL` to the address Alertmanager should use when that loopback address is not reachable. Kubernetes uses the official Node client and read-only kubeconfig credentials, without requiring `kubectl`.

dsh-aiops README · Development：In a Web profile, use the persistent `AIOps` action in the sidebar footer to open the global Portal from any screen. A non-blank Session also exposes the existing `AIOps` conversation view. The Portal always reads `AIOPS_WORKSPACE`; it does not widen scope based on the currently selected chat Session. Prometheus/Alertmanager URLs and the server-side kubeconfig path/context are persisted in DSH user settings and apply live. All three sources must pass connectivity tests; Kubernetes also verifies the minimum read-only RBAC capabilities.

dsh-aiops README · Development：The same workspace manages versioned routing policy. A pasted normalized-label dry-run must succeed before the complete policy is saved atomically with a settings revision fence; changes apply live and are durably audited. The webhook credential remains server-side and the Portal returns only its configured status.

dsh-aiops README · Development：The main DSH repository remains the source of generic Session, query, workflow, permission, and runtime capabilities. This repository owns only the AIOps domain packages and bundle.
